# RVLand Devs

> Custom websites for businesses, designed, written, and launched entirely by message: no calls, no meetings. Flat, transparent pricing listed on the site, with support and hosting included in every plan. Based in Brazil, serving clients internationally in English and Portuguese.

RVLand Devs builds custom websites for small businesses (car washes, local services, and more). The client sends business info by message (Instagram DM, SMS, email, or Messenger), approves a free homepage concept, and the site goes live in days. Every plan includes custom design, copywriting, mobile-responsive layout, basic SEO, Google Maps integration, contact and booking forms, SSL, hosting, and ongoing support.

## Pages

- [Website services in English](https://rvland-page.vercel.app/en): plans, pricing, FAQ, and lead form
- [Pricing](https://rvland-page.vercel.app/en?section=pricing): pay in full or monthly plans, support and hosting included
- [Site em português](https://rvland-page.vercel.app/): desenvolvimento de software sob medida no Brasil

## Facts

- Payment options: one-time payment or monthly installment plans (see live pricing on the site)
- Every plan includes months of support and hosting; afterwards a flat monthly support plan applies
- Communication is 100% by text message; no sales calls or meetings, ever
- Free homepage concept before any payment
- The client owns the website once the plan is paid in full
